show_title: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: WTT: A New Twist on an Old Bet with Buffett
summary:
The bet took on a life of its
own, and I benefited from it far differently than I imagined at its
inception. Almost two decades later, I have an idea for
another bet with similar intrigue. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more.
